limitations: Predicted RGB remains a low-texture gray body at both steps; visual improvement is small at contact-sheet scale.
Absence of gross head/eye or hand/finger contamination is a runtime-canary observation, not a fine-detail quality claim.
review_method: All 24 original-resolution contact sheets were opened; each sheet contains eight labeled per-query composites, covering every one of the 192 persisted query visual paths.
